thesis: The episode introduces two quants, Moritz Seibert and Moritz Heiden, who transitioned from traditional quantitative asset management and derivatives trading to running a crypto hedge fund called Exponential Age. Their journey involves moving from roles at firms like Scalable Capital and Munich Reinvestment Partners to focusing on digital assets, NFT markets, and emerging strategies in the crypto space.
